text: [shouting] YOU! Yes, you! I hear you're quitting "on Monday"? [sarcastic] Which Monday, soldier? [commanding] We start TODAY. Someone who cares about you sent me. Drop that cigarette!
[shouting] SO WE'RE SMOKING IN SECRET NOW? [whispering] I can smell it from here, soldier. [shouting] You're not fooling anyone! Someone who cares about you sent me. Dismissed!
[shouting] PUT AWAY THAT SMOKING USB STICK! [sarcastic] A vape in your hand all day long, and you call that quitting? [commanding] Someone who cares about you sent me. We start. NOW.
[shouting] YOU SLIPPED? [calm] Fine. It happens to the best. [shouting] But a soldier who falls GETS BACK UP! Someone who cares about you sent me. On your feet, we go again!
[shouting] ANOTHER SMOKE BREAK? [sarcastic] Do you work between cigarettes, or is it the other way around? [commanding] Someone who cares about you sent me. Breaks are over. Attention!
[shouting] CIGARETTES TOO EXPENSIVE? [sarcastic] Then stop buying them, genius! [commanding] Someone who cares about you sent me. From now on, we save!
[shouting] ATTENTION! [proud] I hear you quit, soldier. [softly] I'm proud of you. [shouting] But you do NOT lower your guard! Someone who cares about you sent me. Keep going!
[shouting] You already burned all that? [commanding] And that's ONLY the beginning, soldier. Quit while it doesn't cost you a car yet!
[shouting] ALL THAT UP IN SMOKE? [disgusted] A vacation, a motorbike, a savings account... And you picked black lungs. BRAVO.
[shouting] A CAR! You smoked A CAR, soldier! [commanding] It ends today. Not tomorrow. TODAY!
[shouting] A HOUSE down payment. You smoked a house down payment! [quietly] I... I'm speechless. [shouting] NO, I AM NOT SPEECHLESS! QUIT!
[shouting] YOU! YES, YOU, BEHIND THAT SCREEN! You came looking for help? You're gonna get it. ATTENTION!
[commanding] Welcome to Operation Black Lungs. No hugs here, no excuses. [shouting] Just you, me, and your LAST cigarette!
[commanding] Three hundred sixty-five days. One order a day. [shouting] And in the end, YOU'RE the boss, not the cigarette. DISMISSED!
[shouting] RECRUIT REGISTERED! [commanding] On D-Day, I'm coming for you. Get ready, soldier!
